_meta.description: Libya annual gas flaring volume, billion cubic meters (bcm), as reported by the World Bank Global Gas Flaring Reduction (GGFR) / Global Flaring and Methane Reduction Partnership (GFMR) satellite-based flaring tracker. Only years with a directly verified, citable figure are included — gaps are left out rather than estimated, to avoid presenting invented numbers. Visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/gasflaringreduction/global-flaring-data for the complete official dataset.
